prose: In classic DeMystifiers style, one stream is never enough! Tonight we return to finish the job, exploring specific social events pre-echoed in the many Marvel Avengers movies, the leveraging of trauma to wire specific neural pathways in the audience, and the esoteric symbolism laid up in the series.
The Marvelous DeMystifiers are: Chance Garton, Gabriel (Slick Dissident), & Gordan Hamil.
